title: Madman
author: Ove Friman
description:
You're Ike Nash, a New York City cop waiting for a big break. That arrives when an inmate escapes from an asylum and the murders start piling up...

An old-school text adventure, written by Ove Friman in 1983, in Basic for the Commodore VIC-20.

Ported by Fredrik Ramsberg to Inform 6 + NAIL / Z-code in 2026.
